findings.title: Liability cap carve-outs
findings.deviation: The MSA includes 'gross negligence' as a category for the uncapped indemnity (Clause 12.1), whereas the playbook prefers carve-outs to be limited to fraud, wilful misconduct, and confidentiality.
findings.impact: AtliQ's liability for third-party claims arising from gross negligence would be uncapped rather than limited to the SOW fees.
findings.quote: Each Party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising out of its breach of confidentiality, infringement of intellectual property rights, or gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
findings.counterPosition: Limit carve-outs from the liability cap to fraud, wilful misconduct, and breach of confidentiality only.

fine.note: Delay penalties match the 0.5% per week rate, are capped at 5% of the milestone fee, exclude client-caused delays, and are the sole remedy for delay.
Payment within 30 days of receipt matches the playbook standard.
IP ownership vests in the client upon payment, with AtliQ retaining ownership of background IP and granting a perpetual license.
The convenience termination clause ensures AtliQ is paid for all work performed up to the termination date.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 3-year survival period.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to employees, which is acceptable.
Data protection liability is subject to the general aggregate cap, avoiding the risk of uncapped data incident liability.
The 7-day review period and deemed acceptance upon production use are in line with standard practice.
The indemnity is mutual and covers each party's own breaches and negligence.
